--!strict
-- UiTheme: pure shared UI kit for the house Theme (no side effects, no server code).
-- Palette matches the HUD / cash look: yellow Primary, green Good, red Bad, blue Info, dark Ink outlines.
-- Telemetry (shop_opened, shop_purchases) is counted by the server-side owner of those events, not here.

local UiTheme = {}

-- Colors
UiTheme.ink = Color3.fromRGB(28, 22, 38)
UiTheme.cream = Color3.fromRGB(255, 248, 232)
UiTheme.panel = Color3.fromRGB(255, 248, 232)
UiTheme.card = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
UiTheme.text = Color3.fromRGB(28, 22, 38)
UiTheme.accent = Color3.fromRGB(255, 196, 41)
UiTheme.good = Color3.fromRGB(88, 214, 92)
UiTheme.bad = Color3.fromRGB(240, 68, 64)
UiTheme.info = Color3.fromRGB(64, 170, 255)
UiTheme.dim = Color3.fromRGB(190, 184, 176)
UiTheme.locked = Color3.fromRGB(120, 112, 134)

-- Fonts and metrics
UiTheme.font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
UiTheme.headerFont = Enum.Font.LuckiestGuy
UiTheme.cornerRadius = 14
UiTheme.stroke = 3
UiTheme.minButtonHeight = 48 -- at least 44 px touch target
UiTheme.padding = 10

-- Adds a UICorner to a GuiObject (reuses an existing one).
function UiTheme.roundify(guiObject: GuiObject, radius: number?)
	local corner = guiObject:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
	if not corner then
		corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.Parent = guiObject
	end
	(corner :: UICorner).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or UiTheme.cornerRadius)
end

-- Returns a big readable TextButton.
-- props: text, size, position, anchorPoint, color, textColor, parent, name, zIndex, layoutOrder, onClick
function UiTheme.makeButton(props: { [string]: any }): TextButton
	local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
	button.Name = props.name or "Button"
	button.Text = props.text or ""
	local size: UDim2 = props.size or UDim2.fromOffset(160, UiTheme.minButtonHeight)
	if size.Y.Offset < UiTheme.minButtonHeight and size.Y.Scale == 0 then
		size = UDim2.new(size.X.Scale, size.X.Offset, 0, UiTheme.minButtonHeight)
	end
	button.Size = size
	button.Position = props.position or UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	button.AnchorPoint = props.anchorPoint or Vector2.new(0, 0)
	button.BackgroundColor3 = props.color or UiTheme.accent
	button.TextColor3 = props.textColor or UiTheme.cream
	button.Font = UiTheme.headerFont
	button.TextScaled = true
	button.AutoButtonColor = true
	button.BorderSizePixel = 0
	button.ZIndex = props.zIndex or 1
	button.LayoutOrder = props.layoutOrder or 0

	UiTheme.roundify(button, UiTheme.cornerRadius)

	local border = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	border.Thickness = UiTheme.stroke
	border.Color = UiTheme.ink
	border.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	border.Parent = button

	local textStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	textStroke.Thickness = UiTheme.stroke
	textStroke.Color = UiTheme.ink
	textStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual
	textStroke.Parent = button

	local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0.16, 0)
	pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0.16, 0)
	pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6)
	pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6)
	pad.Parent = button

	local minSize = Instance.new("UISizeConstraint")
	minSize.MinSize = Vector2.new(44, UiTheme.minButtonHeight)
	minSize.Parent = button

	local onClick = props.onClick
	if typeof(onClick) == "function" then
		button.Activated:Connect(function()
			onClick()
		end)
	end

	if props.parent then
		button.Parent = props.parent
	end
	return button
end

return UiTheme

# Lessons
## Design
- Tune early progression so a playtest of roughly 15 seconds can reach the first purchase or milestone. Use a fast starting income or a cheap first upgrade (a few seconds of income). Slow openings leave the buy loop untested and feel dull. Keep the second purchase within about 20-30s of idle income, by raising per-item value or lowering the price. Chain the first few upgrades so there is always something affordable to chase in the first minute, with no long dead gaps.
- Starting cash must be strictly below the first upgrade's price, never equal to it. An instant spend gives the player no chase and no sense of what cubes are for. Start slightly below the price so the first few collected cubes earn it, within about 10s. Check starter cash against the first cost in config before finishing.
- The first purchase must actually happen in a short playtest, and its counters (e.g. upgrades_bought) must be above 0. If the report lacks them, the first pad is too hard to find or reach. ## UI kit (house style for all UI: paste the snippets you use, Theme first, and adapt; plain Luau, not modules)
- Chunky text: every label gets a dark UIStroke (2.5-4 px). LuckiestGuy for titles/numbers, FredokaOne for body. Never default or thin fonts.
- One palette everywhere: yellow Primary = main action, green Good = affordable/claim, red Bad = close/can't, blue Info = secondary, dark Ink outlines.
- Depth: UICorner 12-18 px, UIStroke border, light-top UIGradient fill, hard drop shadow 4-6 px below.
- Everything moves: appear with a Back-eased UIScale pop (0 -> 1), react with a punch (1.2 -> 1), press squish to 0.9. Tween UIScale, not Size; 0.1-0.4 s, never linear.
- Numbers tick up and pop on change, big values short ("12.5K"); gains flash green, losses red.
- Every action gives feedback: toast, floating "+N" or reward popup. Max 3 toasts.
- Mobile first: 1280x720 offsets under a viewport UIScale (`Theme.screen`), safe insets, buttons >= 44 px, nothing key in the top-left (Roblox menu).
- HUD hugs the edges, centre stays clear; windows open over a dim backdrop with a close X.
- World prices on BillboardGuis: green when affordable, red when not.
- UI is built in code with Instance.new, no image asset ids (emoji/letters for icons), ResetOnSpawn = false.

-- PriceBillboard: world price tag over a buy pad / shop item; green when affordable, red when not. Server or client.
-- Standalone (no Theme needed) so a server Script can paste it too.
local function priceBillboard(part: BasePart, title: string, price: number): (BillboardGui, (boolean) -> ())
	local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bb.Size, bb.StudsOffset = UDim2.fromScale(6, 2.2), Vector3.new(0, part.Size.Y / 2 + 2, 0)
	bb.AlwaysOnTop, bb.MaxDistance, bb.LightInfluence = false, 80, 0
	bb.Adornee = part
	local function text(t: string, y: number, h: number, color: Color3): TextLabel
		local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		l.Size, l.Position, l.BackgroundTransparency = UDim2.fromScale(1, h), UDim2.fromScale(0, y), 1
		l.Text, l.Font, l.TextScaled, l.TextColor3 = t, Enum.Font.LuckiestGuy, true, color
		local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		s.Thickness, s.Color = 3, Color3.fromRGB(28, 22, 38)
		s.Parent = l
		l.Parent = bb
		return l
	end
	text(title, 0, 0.45, Color3.fromRGB(255, 248, 232))
	local cost = text("$" .. tostring(price), 0.45, 0.55, Color3.fromRGB(240, 68, 64))
	bb.Parent = part
	local function setAffordable(ok: boolean)
		cost.TextColor3 = if ok then Color3.fromRGB(88, 214, 92) else Color3.fromRGB(240, 68, 64)
	end
	return bb, setAffordable -- client: call setAffordable(cash.Value >= price) on cash.Changed
end

-- Active punch tweens per GuiObject (weak keys so destroyed gui objects are collected).
local activePunch: { [Instance]: Tween } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: any

-- Punch: pops a GuiObject to 1.15x and back with Back easing in 0.18s total.
-- Uses a UIScale child so layouts and text sizes are untouched. Call on every cash change.
function UiTheme.punch(guiObject: GuiObject, peak: number?)
	if not guiObject or not guiObject.Parent then
		return
	end
	local uiScale = guiObject:FindFirstChild("PunchScale")
	if not uiScale or not uiScale:IsA("UIScale") then
		local created = Instance.new("UIScale")
		created.Name = "PunchScale"
		created.Scale = 1
		created.Parent = guiObject
		uiScale = created
	end
	local scaleObj = uiScale :: UIScale

	local running = activePunch[guiObject]
	if running then
		running:Cancel()
		activePunch[guiObject] = nil
	end
	scaleObj.Scale = 1

	local info = TweenInfo.new(0.09, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	local up = TweenService:Create(scaleObj, info, { Scale = peak or 1.15 })
	local down = TweenService:Create(scaleObj, info, { Scale = 1 })
	activePunch[guiObject] = up
	up.Completed:Once(function(state: Enum.PlaybackState)
		if state ~= Enum.PlaybackState.Completed then
			return
		end
		if scaleObj.Parent then
			activePunch[guiObject] = down
			down:Play()
		end
	end)
	up:Play()
end

export type GoalBar = {

function UiTheme.makeGoalBar(props: { [string]: any }): GoalBar
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")

	frame.Size = props.size or UDim2.fromOffset(220, 26)
	frame.Position = props.position or UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)

	frame.BackgroundColor3 = UiTheme.ink
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.ZIndex = props.zIndex or 1
	frame.ClipsDescendants = true

	border.Thickness = UiTheme.stroke
	border.Color = UiTheme.ink
	border.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	border.Parent = frame

	local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
	fill.Name = "Fill"
	fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
	fill.BackgroundColor3 = UiTheme.good
	fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
	fill.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 1
	UiTheme.roundify(fill, 10)
	fill.Parent = frame

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = "Label"
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = props.text or "Next goal"
	label.Font = UiTheme.headerFont
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.TextColor3 = UiTheme.cream
	label.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 2
	local labelStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	labelStroke.Thickness = 2.5
	labelStroke.Color = UiTheme.ink
	labelStroke.Parent = label
	local labelPad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	labelPad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0.12, 0)
	labelPad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0.12, 0)
	labelPad.Parent = label
	label.Parent = frame

	local flashTween: Tween? = nil
	local fillTween: Tween? = nil
	local flashing = false

	local function setFlashing(on: boolean)
		if on == flashing then
			return
		end
		flashing = on
		if flashTween then
			flashTween:Cancel()
			flashTween = nil
		end
		if on then
			local t = TweenService:Create(
				fill,
				TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true),
				{ BackgroundColor3 = UiTheme.accent }
			)
			flashTween = t
			t:Play()
			UiTheme.punch(frame, 1.1)
		else
			fill.BackgroundColor3 = UiTheme.good
		end
	end

	local function update(current: number, cost: number, text: string?)
		if text then
			label.Text = text
		end
		local ratio = 1
		if cost > 0 then
			ratio = math.clamp(current / cost, 0, 1)
		end
		if fillTween then
			fillTween:Cancel()
		end
		local t = TweenService:Create(
			fill,
			TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{ Size = UDim2.fromScale(ratio, 1) }
		)
		fillTween = t
		t:Play()
		setFlashing(current >= cost and cost > 0)
	end

	local function destroy()
		if flashTween then
			flashTween:Cancel()
			flashTween = nil
		end
		if fillTween then
			fillTween:Cancel()
			fillTween = nil
		end
		frame:Destroy()
	end

	if props.parent then
		frame.Parent = props.parent
	end

	return {
		frame = frame,
		fill = fill,
		label = label,
		update = update,
		destroy = destroy,
	}
